LaunchKit.AspNetCore 1.0.0
Launch essentials for ASP.NET Core MVC, scaffolded by one command.

Usage:
  launchkit [options]                  run in the current project folder
  launchkit --project <path.csproj>    run against a specific project

Options:
  --base-url <url>     Public site origin, e.g. https://example.com.
                       Required the first time sitemap.xml and robots.txt are written;
                       stored in launchkit.json and reused afterwards.
  --company <name>     Legal entity named in the generated legal pages.
  --site <name>        Display name of the site used in the generated legal pages.
  --email <address>    Contact address printed in the generated legal pages.
  --dry-run            Report every change without writing anything.
  --no-color           Disable ANSI colour.
  --ascii              Use ASCII markers instead of Unicode.
  --version            Print the version and exit.
  --help               Show this help.

Running again is safe: files you have edited are preserved and only the
LaunchKit-managed sitemap is regenerated.
